title: langchain-core==1.8.0
excerpt: langchain-core 1.8.0 drops support for Python 3.10 , which has reached end-of-life. The minimum supported version is now Python 3.11. Users on Python 3.10 will continue to resolve langchain-core 1.7.x. Changes since langchain-core==1.7.7 release(core): 1.8.0 ( #41796 ) feat(core): Remove EOL Python 3.10 support ( #41267 ) feat(core): add decision models ( #41765 )
